name: TEMP - Trustpilot feasibility test
description: Temporary feasibility test: fetches public Trustpilot pages for all 13 brands from n8n and records status, presence of embedded page data, pagination depth and review field names into a temporary data table.

parameters.content:
## TEMPORARY - Trustpilot feasibility test

Fetches page 1 for all 13 brands from n8n, plus an all-languages variant and pages 2, 50 and 130 for Personality, with standard headers. Records status, whether the page data is present, pagination and review fields into tmp_trustpilot_feasibility.

Delete once the collector is built.
